newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs, pork bellies jump limit on Japan buying.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs, pork bellies jump limit on Japan buying.

text.p: CME pork belly futures sped to limit gains of 3.00 cents per lb in four nearby contracts, with buying sparked by news that Japan will continue to buy U.S. pork bellies until late May, CME traders said.

CME lean hog futures briefly posted limit gains of 2.00 cents early, and later traded sharply higher in reaction to the Japanese news as well as to $1.00 to $2.00 per cwt gains in cash hog prices Thursday.
